desc:
You know... I really like the image that Chimata is not average height, but actually short. 🤔 And when thinking about Chimata, the keyword Capitalism would come to mind, but I think she can be much more foundational than that? A market god. Trade. Transaction. Exchange of goods. This kind of thing transcends categorization of economy.

And [**Chimata says that**](https://en.touhouwiki.net/wiki/Unconnected_Marketeers/Story/Sanae's_Scenario#:~:text=天狗風情) after Tsukasa whispered to her.
